correctness.rationale: For permutations represented by two strict total orders, two-round EF equivalence is equality of the collections of four-quadrant occupancy masks. Only nine adjacent-pair/triple/full masks persist with probability tending to one. The displayed nine-point witness (3,2,5,9,1,6,4,8,7) realizes all nine and distinctness forces minimal order nine. The record-maxima Bernoulli-sum distribution gives exact P(R_n<=2)=(1+H_(n-1))/n; missing triple masks is bounded by that event plus direct-sum pivot probabilities O(n^-2). Endpoint and midpoint bounds control the other eight masks, proving two-sided Theta(log n/n). A rank-three sentence requiring adjacent increasing values at adjacent positions has Poisson(1) occurrences by factorial moments of required value-successor runs, hence limit 1-e^-1.
